instruction: I'm about to start cooking, could you please pick up a potato for me?
knowledge: Experience: My prediction that the robot would move 0.5 units ahead toward the potato was wrong because a stool was blocking the path, causing the move action to fail. Lesson: Before issuing a movement command, verify the path is clear of obstacles and replan around or remove any obstruction instead of assuming forward movement will succeed.

Experience: My prediction that moving 0.5 meters ahead would succeed and continue toward the potato was wrong because Stool_c2b66393 was blocking Agent 0's path, causing the move to fail. Lesson: Before moving toward a target, check the intended path for obstacles and respond to blockage by navigating around, removing the obstacle, or replanning instead of assuming forward movement is clear.

instruction: Prepare a mug of coffee, drink it, then wash and store the mug.
knowledge: Experience: My prediction that the robot would be holding the mug after executing pickup was wrong because the pickup action failed, likely since the mug was not confirmed to be present, reachable, or within the robot's current location. Lesson: Before attempting to pick up an object, verify that it exists in the environment and is reachable, such as by navigating to its location or checking its visibility, rather than assuming pickup will succeed.

instruction: Deliver a green round fruit to the intended a large gray piece of furniture with a backrest by physically moving it there.
knowledge: Experience: My prediction that the robot would be holding the green apple after executing skill_33_pick_up_the_apple was wrong because the apple was not near the robot, making the pick-up action invalid. Lesson: Before attempting to pick up an object, verify that it is nearby or within reach; if it is not, navigate to the object's location first.

Experience: My prediction that the green round fruit was placed on the sofa was wrong because I attempted to place an object while the robot was not holding it; the place action failed since the robot must be holding something before placing it. Lesson: Always verify the robot is holding the target object, or perform a successful pick action first, before attempting any place action.

instruction: Fry a potato slice and serve it on a plate
knowledge: Experience: My prediction that the robot would locate a potato was wrong because the find action for potato failed immediately with a StepError, indicating the object was likely not available, not visible, or not recognized in the current environment. Lesson: Before assuming a target object can be found, verify object availability through scene inspection, known locations, or prior observations; if a find action fails, treat the object as unavailable and switch to exploration or an alternative rather than proceeding as if it succeeded.

instruction: Reproduce the target viewpoint: match the target image's position and camera angle.
knowledge: Experience: My prediction that executing MoveAhead would move the robot forward and get closer to the target viewpoint was wrong because the action was blocked, indicating an obstacle, wall, or navigational boundary in front of the agent. Lesson: Never assume MoveAhead will succeed; verify that the forward path is clear, and when blocked, rotate, strafe, or choose an alternate route instead of expecting forward progress.

instruction: Move a spoon from the right counter to the right receptacle of the left counter.
knowledge: Experience: My prediction that the robot would be holding the spoon after executing skill_26_pick_up_the_spoon was wrong because the spoon was not near the robot; the robot had not navigated to the spoon's location on the right counter first. Lesson: Before attempting a pick-up action, always navigate to the object's location and verify that the object is within reach/proximity.

Experience: My prediction that the spoon would be placed in the right receptacle of the left counter was wrong because I executed the place skill without first picking up the spoon; the robot was not holding any object, so the placement was invalid. Lesson: Before executing a place action, always verify that the robot is currently holding the target object, and perform a successful pick action first if it is not.

instruction: Move the plate to the black table, the screwdriver to the black table, and the cleanser to the black table.
knowledge: Experience: My prediction that the robot would be holding the cleanser after executing pick_up_the_cleanser was wrong because the robot had not navigated to the cleanser's location, so the object was not near the robot. Lesson: Before attempting to pick up an object, always verify that the robot is at or near the target object's location; if not, navigate there first.
